answer.reason: The verses tell what was made of the coat and what was done with it, which is more than the summary states.

clauses.english: was made by Israel for Joseph, whom he loved more than all his children
clauses.quote: he made him a coat of many colours

clauses.english: was stripped from Joseph by his brothers
clauses.quote: they stript Joseph out of his coat

clauses.english: was dipped in goat's blood and brought to Jacob, who took it as proof that Joseph was devoured
clauses.quote: It is my son's coat; an evil beast hath devoured him

doubts: The summary already names the dipping in blood, so the third clause may partly repeat it; it is kept for the brothers' deceit of their father.
